Important information

Safety Information

If the product is dropped, the brush head should be replaced before the next use even if no damage is visible. Do not use as a toy or without adult supervision. Small parts may pose choking hazard. Do not chew or bite on brush. For cleaning, switch off the handle and remove the brush head. Rinse both parts separately with water and wipe them dry before reassembling. DISPOSE OR RECYCLE BATTERIES IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL REGULATIONS. DO NOT USE ON CHILDREN UNDER AGE 3. PRIOR TO USE, ENSURE THE BRUSH HEAD FITS WELL. REPLACE BRUSH HEAD EVERY 3 MONTHS OR SOONER IF BRUSH HEAD BECOMES WORN OR NO LONGER FITS PROPERLY.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find this toothbrush to be a basic electric model that delivers excellent cleaning without charging hassles, and appreciate its battery-operated design with long-lasting batteries. Moreover, they consider it good value for money, travel-friendly, and easy to use. However, the reliability receives mixed feedback - while some say it works just like an electric model, others report it stops working. Additionally, durability is also mixed, with some saying it lasts a long time while others report it completely dying after three months.

    I bought this toothbrush specifically for my frequent work travel, and it’s been a great choice. It’s the perfect size to fit easily in my luggage, and I love that you don’t have to bring a charger—one less thing to worry about when packing.

    The brushing power is impressive. The first time I used it my mouth felt cleaner than it had been a long time! I barely have to move it; I just gently hold it in place and it cleans better than some of the rechargeable toothbrushes I’ve owned. It feels sturdy and well-made. While it’s a bit heavier than a standard manual toothbrush, it’s not too heavy for travel and actually feels very comfortable to hold. Battery life seems to be holding up strong. I’ve had it for many months.

    Overall, this is a strong, travel-friendly toothbrush that delivers excellent cleaning without the hassle of charging.

  • Sean Bozarth
    3 out of 5 stars
    Easy to use, but noticeably weak power
    Reviewed in the United States on April 23, 2026
    Size: 1 Count (Pack of 1)
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I tried the Oral-B Pro 100 3D White toothbrush, and while it’s simple and easy to use, the overall performance is pretty underwhelming. It runs on regular AA batteries, which makes it convenient, but you can definitely feel the difference compared to rechargeable models.

    The round brush head is nice and does a decent job cleaning tooth by tooth, and it’s compatible with other Oral-B heads, which is a plus. It also has a built-in timer to help with brushing time, so the basics are there.

    That said, the power is where it falls short. It feels weak, especially if you’re used to stronger electric toothbrushes. It gets the job done at a basic level, but it doesn’t give that deep clean feeling you might expect. Even reviews describe it as more of a “basic” option rather than a high-performance one.

    Overall, it’s fine as an entry-level or travel toothbrush, but if you’re looking for something with real power and a stronger clean, this probably won’t be enough.

About this Item

  • Superior plaque removal* for healthy gums *vs. a regular manual toothbrush
  • Precision Clean brush head delivers a dentist inspired tooth-by-tooth cleaning
  • Consistent battery performance. 2 AA batteries included
  • Compatible with other Oral-B Brush Heads: CrossAction, Sensitive, Gum Care, FlossAction, 3D White
  • Oral-B, #1 dentist-recommended toothbrush brand worldwide

Product Description

Power up to a better clean with the Oral-B Pro 100 Precision Clean Battery Power Toothbrush. Your teeth and gums will feel pampered because you're removing more plaque than a regular manual toothbrush each time you brush.

Important Information

Safety Information

If the product is dropped, the brush head should be replaced before the next use even if no damage is visible. Do not use as a toy or without adult supervision. Small parts may pose choking hazard. Do not chew or bite on brush. For cleaning, switch off the handle and remove the brush head. Rinse both parts separately with water and wipe them dry before reassembling. DISPOSE OR RECYCLE BATTERIES IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL REGULATIONS. DO NOT USE ON CHILDREN UNDER AGE 3. PRIOR TO USE, ENSURE THE BRUSH HEAD FITS WELL. REPLACE BRUSH HEAD EVERY 3 MONTHS OR SOONER IF BRUSH HEAD BECOMES WORN OR NO LONGER FITS PROPERLY.
